detailZones.title: Bridge glazing and side walls
detailZones.description: The windows, mullions and side panels line the two sides of the corridor.

detailZones.title: Roof and telescoping vestibule
detailZones.description: Ceiling lights and frames lead to the black folds around the aircraft end of the bridge.

detailZones.title: Bridge controls and emergency phone
detailZones.translation: 廊桥控制装置与应急电话
detailZones.description: The sloping console holds a joystick and red button below the emergency phone.

detailZones.title: Handrails and boarding threshold
detailZones.description: Handrail brackets and a tubular barrier flank the metal threshold.

detailZones.title: Floor and boarding route
detailZones.description: The dark floor panels meet a crosswise metal joint and a metal threshold plate.

detailZones.title: Aircraft door vestibule
detailZones.description: The opening into the aircraft reveals its frame, recessed edges and sill.

anchorAudit.rationale: The red handset, coiled cord, joystick, handrails, floor joints and open aircraft doorway were located on the released photograph. Unseen control parts, unidentifiable seal functions and duplicate names for the same opening are searchable in the index. Earlier operational exclusions remain outside the spatial vocabulary.
